s: a Benedictine abbey on the Danube running the world's oldest monastic brewery, with a legendary beer garden
w: Founded around 600 AD in a dramatic bend of the Danube gorge, Weltenburg Abbey has brewed beer since at least 1050 -- making its Klosterbrauerei the oldest monastery brewery still operating. The riverside beer garden under old chestnut trees, reachable by boat or a walking trail through the gorge, serves the abbey's own dark lager alongside roast pork and bread in a setting that has barely changed its rhythm in centuries.
_facts: Benedictine monastery near Kelheim, Bavaria, founded c. 600 AD in the Danube Gorge (Donaudurchbruch)
Its Klosterbrauerei Weltenburg has brewed beer since at least 1050, making it the world's oldest still-operating monastery brewery
Reachable by boat trip through the Danube gorge or on foot/bike
Riverside beer garden serving the abbey's own beer alongside traditional Bavarian food
